questions.question: Which clause of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 Bill deals with the Directorate of Prosecution, and under which chapter does it fall?
questions.answer: Clause 20, Directorate of Prosecution, appears in Chapter II on the constitution of criminal courts and offices.

questions.question: How long after the Official Gazette publication of a forfeiture declaration under Section 98 can an interested person apply to the High Court to set it aside?
questions.answer: The application must be made within two months from the date the declaration is published in the Official Gazette.

questions.question: Under section 195 of the BNSS, what is the age limit above which a male person cannot be required to attend anywhere other than where he resides when summoned by police during a section 194 investigation?
questions.must_contain: above the age of sixty years
questions.answer: A male person above the age of sixty years (or under fifteen) cannot be required to attend at a place other than his residence unless he is willing to attend at the police station or another place within its limits.

questions.question: Under Section 310 of the BNSS, in what form is a witness's evidence ordinarily taken down in a warrant-case before a Magistrate?
questions.must_contain: in the form of a narrative
questions.answer: Evidence is ordinarily taken down as a narrative, though the Magistrate may in his discretion record any part of it in question and answer form.

questions.question: Under the BNSS 2023, if an accused pleaded guilty and was convicted by a Court of Session or a Magistrate, what can still be appealed?
questions.must_contain: extent or legality of the sentence
questions.answer: Only the extent or legality of the sentence can be appealed; there is no appeal against the conviction itself, and no appeal at all if a High Court convicted on the plea.

questions.question: Under which section of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 must a High Court supervise subordinate Sessions Courts and Judicial Magistrates so that cases are disposed of expeditiously?
questions.must_contain: expeditious and proper disposal of cases
questions.answer: Section 531 requires every High Court to exercise superintendence over subordinate Courts of Session and Judicial Magistrates to ensure expeditious and proper disposal of cases.

questions.question: In the First Schedule classification table of the BNSS 2023, what is the punishment for abetment where the abettor or the person abetted is a public servant whose duty is to prevent the offence?
questions.answer: Imprisonment of one-half of the longest term provided for the offence abetted, or the fine provided for it, or both.

questions.question: What is the punishment, and is the offence bailable, when a public servant or police officer is involved in trafficking of a child under section 141 in the BNSS First Schedule?
questions.must_contain: remainder of that person’s natural life
questions.answer: It is punishable with imprisonment for life (the remainder of the person's natural life) and fine, and it is non-bailable, cognizable and triable by the Court of Session.

questions.question: What is the punishment for wrongfully confining a person for 10 or more days under section 125(4) in the First Schedule of the BNSS, and is it bailable?
questions.answer: It is punishable with imprisonment for 5 years and a fine of 10000 rupees, and the offence is cognizable and non-bailable.

questions.question: Who is allowed to compound the offence of wrongfully confining a person in secret under the BNSS table of compoundable offences, and what is the corresponding BNS section?
questions.answer: Wrongful confinement in secret falls under BNS section 125(6), and it can be compounded by the person confined.

questions.question: Under Section 311 BNSS 2023, in what form is a witness's evidence ordinarily taken down in a Court of Session trial, and when can question and answer form be used?
questions.answer: Evidence is ordinarily recorded as a narrative, but the presiding Judge may in his discretion have any part recorded in question and answer form.
